profiles.title: Torque Calculator
profiles.inputContract: force N, leverArm m, included angle degrees
profiles.historicalWitness: Exact v1 output/steps; no near-parallel rounding normalization
profiles.sourcePrecisionLimits: Near-zero angle and antiparallel trigonometric precision
requiredApprovals: separately scoped Business capability adoption where applicable

profiles.title: Molecular Weight Calculator
profiles.historicalWitness: Retain normalized formula and exact v1 mass replay
profiles.sourcePrecisionLimits: Atomic-weight edition, grammar, molar mass convention
requiredApprovals: separately scoped Business capability adoption where applicable

profiles.title: Fuel Trip Cost Calculator
profiles.inputContract: distance km, fuel L/100 km, currency units/L
profiles.historicalWitness: Retain exact input units and stored v1 result
profiles.sourcePrecisionLimits: Currency, rate and Binary64 precision scope
requiredApprovals: separately scoped Business capability adoption where applicable

profiles.title: Tire Size Calculator
profiles.inputContract: current/new widths mm, aspect ratios %, rim diameters in
profiles.outputContract: two nominal diameters mm, relative diameter difference %, steps
profiles.numericalWitness: 634.3 mm to 653.2 mm; +2.97966%; zero aspect ratio refused
profiles.historicalWitness: Restore both v1 tire tuples; no unit reinterpretation
profiles.sourcePrecisionLimits: Nominal geometry and inch-to-mm convention; fitment excluded
requiredApprovals: separately scoped Business capability adoption where applicable

profiles.title: Fuel Cost Calculator
profiles.inputContract: fuel quantity and price per matching supplied volume unit
profiles.historicalWitness: Preserve result field and exact replay, distinct from #509
requiredApprovals: separately scoped Business capability adoption where applicable

profiles.title: 3D Function Plotter
profiles.inputContract: bounded x/y expression and ordered x/y ranges
profiles.outputContract: gridSize, finite points, sampled minimum/maximum, steps
profiles.numericalWitness: x+y on [-1,1]² yields 289 samples, extremes −2 and 2
profiles.historicalWitness: Sample arrays and skipped-point behavior are replayed exactly
profiles.sourcePrecisionLimits: Grammar, finite sample coverage and limits; no interpolation or global extremum
requiredApprovals: separately scoped Business capability adoption where applicable

profiles.title: MRR Calculator
profiles.inputContract: integer paying customer count and monthly mean revenue per customer
profiles.sourcePrecisionLimits: Population, period, currency and rounding scope
requiredApprovals: separately scoped Business capability adoption where applicable

profiles.title: ARR Calculator
profiles.inputContract: supplied monthly recurring revenue in one currency
profiles.historicalWitness: Exact normalized v1 annualized result replay
profiles.sourcePrecisionLimits: Annualization vs earned revenue and currency precision
requiredApprovals: separately scoped Business capability adoption where applicable

profiles.title: Runway Calculator
profiles.inputContract: cash balance and positive monthly burn in the same currency
profiles.historicalWitness: Positive 0.00000001 cash divided by 1 remains historical v1 zero
profiles.sourcePrecisionLimits: Constant-burn applicability, near-zero and six-decimal policy
requiredApprovals: separately scoped Business capability adoption where applicable

profiles.title: Root Finder Calculator
profiles.numericalWitness: x²−4 on [0,4] returns 2, residual zero, one iteration
profiles.historicalWitness: Exact v1 bracket; endpoint root retains zero iterations
profiles.sourcePrecisionLimits: Bisection tolerance, residual, count and refusal, no root completeness inference
requiredApprovals: separately scoped Business capability adoption where applicable

profiles.title: Air Density Calculator
profiles.inputContract: absolute pressure Pa and dry-air Celsius temperature
profiles.numericalWitness: 86,115 Pa and 26.85 °C gives 1 kg/m³; zero pressure refused
profiles.historicalWitness: Original exact dry-air v1 snapshot and rounded output
profiles.sourcePrecisionLimits: Dry ideal gas only; humid air and other thermodynamic ranges not approved
requiredApprovals: separately scoped Business capability adoption where applicable
